shared_task_paper.title: Findings of the MMLoSo 2025 Shared Task on Machine Translation into Tribal Languages

current_related_dataset_card.title: AdiBhashaa: A Community-Curated Benchmark for Machine Translation into Indian Tribal Languages

deterministic_reconciliation.reason: The current AdiBhasha card describes a later, gated 80,000-sentence benchmark with approximately 20,150 Mundari training pairs and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while the shared-task paper reports 20,000 parallel pairs per language and a 16,000-sentence evaluation set. These differences prevent treating the current card as the exact shared-task manifestation without direct file/version lineage evidence.

release_effect.remaining_blocker: Obtain direct shared-task dataset manifestation/version/file metadata and establish or reject exact lineage to the current AdiBhasha repository before row-level ingestion or dataset identity registration.
